The mod's German table was read only to confirm the key set.
revision_0_5_4.not_translated: The cheat test command socialsystem_fake and its console output (the mod author's solo test tool; its subcommand words are compared in the same methods that print them) and BepInEx log lines.

revision_0_5_4.rebinding_check: The profile updated these mods after their catalogs were bound, so Tolmach skipped their code adapters (runtime report). In the new DLLs every catalog literal is still in the same method (150 values); the English dictionaries and the six More_World_Locations tutorials are byte-identical; new code strings are internal names and log lines. Catalog texts are unchanged.
revision_0_5_4.code_changed: A module bound to another plugin version keeps its code and screen adapters: each rule matches exact catalog strings in named methods, so the strings still present are translated and the missing ones are reported (CatalogLoader.TryBind, DisplayPatches). Setting Compatibility.OnlyAuditedVersions (default off) restores native dictionaries only; it replaces AllowOtherVersions, whose saved false would have kept the old behavior.

revision_0_6_0.not_translated: By the owner's decision: console help and output of JereKuusela's admin tools and the ConditionalConfigSync rejection window. Infinity Hammer tool names from its data file.
revision_0_6_0.code_changed: Pattern arguments item and itemSet (GameItems): a game object a mod prints by its identifier is shown under the game's own localized name, read from ObjectDB; used for the set block of Recipe Description Expansion. Catalog field replaceNative: keys whose Russian replaces the mod's own Russian (owner's decision, MissingPieces), in the Jotunn scope, the AddWord guard and the injection of the game table; every other key stays fill-only. check_po no longer reports 'unchanged' for units without letters outside tokens. Test RawCatalogEntriesTranslateOnDisplay fills numeric placeholders of raw patterns with numbers. CallSites: a method Harmony cannot rebuild (exception filter, fault block) keeps its body; the display methods it calls (GUI.Window, Character.Message and the Player.Message override, MessageHud.ShowMessage) translate their text argument with that mod's catalog when the direct caller is that method, which returns the window titles of the Traders Extended configuration editor.
revision_0_6_0.owner_decisions: 2026-09-29: console of JereKuusela's tools - not needed; Recipe Description Expansion - improve; ConditionalConfigSync - not needed; MissingPieces mistakes - fix.
